label: Two Inverted Pleated + Flaps
description: This unusual chest pocket combines an inverted pleat running down the centre of the patch — allowing the pocket to expand outward when loaded — with two flanking flaps that frame the opening on either side, creating an articulated, almost architectural appearance on the chest. It is a sporting and highly individual option, more often found on elaborate country or shooting jackets than on city suits. The construction demands considerable skill and signals a client comfortable with visible tailoring craft.
